title: Coordination journal — Harper (daily ops)
content:
Quick context: jam-packed day, hybrid schedule, 4 interviews to confirm and 2 candidate follow-ups. Use this as my live running log — delete or move to personal notes after EOD.

Morning checklist (start at 08:30)
- [ ] Review morning queue: messages from hiring managers (ask for hard availability windows).
- [ ] Confirm interview rooms (virt-rooms + 2 on-site rooms B2/B3).
- [ ] Send 3 follow-ups to no-shows from last week (short, flexible windows).
- [ ] Pull updated panel lists for Backend Eng and SRE -> ensure backup interviewer assigned.

Candidate follow-ups (priority order)
1) Priya N. (on-site loop) — needs parking pass and travel stipend note. Call scheduled? NO. Action: email template A, ask for arrival time, cc recruiter. Target: EOD.
2) Marcus L. (final hire loop) — requested salary range confirmation and start-date options. Action: ping hiring manager (Ayesha) for final approval; include LM calendar link. Status: waiting LM.
3) Zoe P. (take-home exercise) — submitted solution; interview panel wants 30-min sync. Action: propose 3 slots (Thu 10:00, Thu 14:00, Fri 09:30 PT).
4) Tasha I. (phone screen) — timezone UTC+2; prefer mornings. Action: schedule for 11:00 UTC (19:00 local) or offer morning window next Tue.

Interview confirmations (today)
- 09:30 PT — Backend phone screen (panel: Liam, Omar). Room: virt-#3. Pre-brief doc: link in ticket. Remind panel at 09:00 PT.
- 11:00 PT — SRE loop (onsite B3 + Zoom fallback). Note: candidate asks for laptop adapter; inform building ops.
- 13:30 PT — Hiring manager deep-dive (resched request from HM?) check slack #hm-updates.
- 16:00 PT — Final loop scheduling for Data Eng (candidate timezone PST) — ensure Slack invite to candidate oriented channel.

Email templates (shortcuts I use)
- Template A (parking + travel): "Hi {name}, welcome — quick note: we have a visitor parking pass for you, and can reimburse travel up to $XX. Please share arrival time so we can have badge ready. — Harper"
- Template B (reschedule ask): "Hi {name}, apologies — interviewer had an urgent conflict. Can we move to one of these: {slot1}, {slot2}, {slot3}? Thanks for flexibility."
- Template C (take-home ack + panel sync): "Thanks for submitting. Panel reviewed; we'd like a 30-min sync to discuss your responses. Please pick from: {slots}."

Blocking items & escalations
- Background check vendor flagged incomplete address for candidate Marcus L. Action: ask candidate for confirmation and escalate to recruiting lead if not returned by EOD.
- Onsite security request: extra badge for Marcus on Monday. Submit form by Friday COB.
- Interview panel burnout: panels flagged very tight spacing today. Suggest manager-owned buffer of 10–15 min between back-to-back loops for energy and notes. Draft note to product managers.

Notes to self (operational hacks)
- Always include candidate local time in invites (I format like: "10:00 PT / 18:00 CET").
- Put "Do not cancel unless" clause in HM reminder to avoid last-minute changes.
- Keep 30-min unscheduled block at 15:00 for triage — today may need it.

End-of-day wrap (EOD checklist)
- [ ] Close out follow-ups (Priya, Marcus, Zoe, Tasha).
- [ ] Update ATS statuses: 4 interviews -> mark outcomes + notes.
- [ ] File expense note for onsite parking (attach receipts).
- [ ] Slack quick sync with Ayesha: confirm background check clearance process timeline.

Misc scratch bits (throwaway)
- Candidate Marcus prefers starting July 6th; double-check payroll lead calendar.
- Liam asked for a one-sentence candidate summary in calendar invites — add to template.
- Build ops contact: rosie.building@redwoodinfra.com (for adapters / on-site equipment).

Random reminders I keep forgetting
- Add Friday "panel retrospective" invite (15 min) for recurring learnings.
- Revisit interview debrief template to include "technical areas to probe" checkbox.

Today wins (small)
- Confirmed alternate room for SRE loop with 10-min notice.
- Got quick LM approval for candidate phone screen (saved 2 days).

If time permits (nice-to-have)
- Clean up templated emails and add to canned responses list in Gmail.
- Draft short doc: "How to route no-shows" for new coordinators.

Timestamped log (scratch)
- 08:35 AM — pulled morning queue, no urgent flags.
- 08:52 AM — emailed Marcus re: address + salary Q.
- 09:05 AM — set up virt-#3 and pinged panel.
- 09:58 AM — candidate no-show for 09:30 -> left voicemail, reschedule offer sent.

-- Harper
